scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outdir=dist
scripts.export: npm run build && mkdir -p skills/tasks && cp dist/index.js skills/tasks/tasks.js && if [ -f .env ]; then cp .env skills/tasks/.env; fi
